input: Register my business name with the state formally

gold.taskTitle: Register Business Name Formally With the State
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to officially register their business name with their state government.

questions.title: Which state are you registering the business in?
questions.description: Identify the specific U.S. state where the business name registration will be filed.

questions.title: What is the exact business name you want to register?
questions.description: Capture the precise name the user intends to register with the state.

questions.title: What business structure are you registering under?
questions.description: Determine if this is a sole proprietorship, LLC, corporation, partnership, or other entity type, as this affects the registration process.

questions.title: Is this a DBA or a formal legal entity registration?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a fictitious business name (DBA/trade name) or is forming a new legal entity such as an LLC.

questions.title: Have you already checked if the name is available?
questions.description: Find out if the user has done a name availability search or needs that included in the plan.

questions.title: Do you have a registered agent identified for the filing?
questions.description: Determine if the user already has a registered agent or needs to find one, which is required for most formal entity registrations.

questions.title: What is your target deadline to complete this registration?
questions.description: Establish a timeline so the task plan can be sequenced with appropriate urgency.
